decisions.reason: The button-input decision is an independent clause of message 887 and is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the VRTC/VBACKUP change does not alter it.
The PIR and touch biasing decision is an independent clause already represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE; the VRTC/VBACKUP change does not alter it.
Leaving VRTC unconnected and exposing an unpopulated VBACKUP pad does not change the display-backlight circuit, supply selection, or population rules.
The auxiliary-pin decision does not change the placement or identity of the AXP2101 and MT3608 decoupling capacitors.

The decision retains use of the AXP2101 and only specifies VRTC/VBACKUP pin handling; it does not change the selected power-management component, required rails, charging behavior, or efficiency goal.
The VRTC/VBACKUP pin decision is unrelated to the ESP32 local-decoupling configuration.
Locating a small VBACKUP pad or via beside PWROK does not necessarily change any recorded board-orientation, connector-placement, enclosure-access, or antenna-clearance constraint.
The AXP2101 backup-power and RTC-pin handling does not change the required current-measurement capability or the conditional omission of a separate INA device.
The auxiliary-pin decision does not affect the quantity, type, interface, or purpose of the display light-sensor connector.
Exposing an unpopulated VBACKUP pad does not revise the recorded cost goal, component-tier preference, connector-reduction policy, or sourcing exception.
The VRTC/VBACKUP handling remains within the existing integrated board and does not change the single-board architecture or functional-consolidation requirement.
A small test pad or via is not a necessary change to the requirement that connectors use through-hole assembly.
